questions.question: What three themes should a reader take away from your resume in the first 10 seconds?
Exact job title(s) as you want them on the resume (include level if relevant).
Employer name (and parent company if known/acquired).
Start date (month/year) and end date or "Present".
In plain language, what does the company do and who pays for it (B2B, B2C, internal)?
In 2–3 sentences, what were you hired to do?
In 2–3 sentences, what did you **actually** end up doing (often broader/narrower)?
What did you own end-to-end (codebase, service, product area, process)?
List up to 10 measurable outcomes tied to your work (metric + before/after or absolute result).
If you had to pick **one** headline metric for this role, what would it be?
Why did this project exist (problem statement)?
What was uniquely yours on this project?
What metrics moved post-launch (or what qualitative signal confirmed success)?
What might a skeptical interviewer doubt—what evidence addresses that doubt?
List tools, frameworks, and cloud services you can defend in interview (comma-separated or bullets).
